items.t: Valve cover gasket leaks oil onto the alternator
items.job: Replace valve cover gaskets and spark plug tube seals
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $833-$1,034; owners report dealer quotes up to about $1,400.

items.t: Alternator fails and the van loses power
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $372-$540. Fix the oil leak first.

items.t: Power sliding doors won't latch or open by themselves
items.job: Repair power sliding door latch, switches or controller

items.t: Front lower control arms can rust through and break (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Hyundai dealer

items.t: Hood can fly open from a corroded safety latch (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Hyundai dealer

items.t: ABS module can short and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Hyundai dealer

items.t: Shifter can leave Park and brake lights may fail (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Hyundai dealer

items.t: Brake lights stay on or don't light from a faulty switch (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Hyundai dealer

items.t: Brake light wiring can rub on the steering shaft (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Hyundai dealer

items.t: Engine stalls or loses power while driving
items.note: Diagnosis only; RepairPal lists about $122-$179. The repair depends on the cause.

items.t: Driver seat mounts crack and the seat rocks
items.job: Replace driver seat frame or seat assembly
items.note: One owner was quoted $2,700 for a new seat; a used seat costs much less.

items.t: Airbag or seat belt warning light stays on
items.note: Diagnosis only; sensor or seat parts cost extra.

items.t: Shifter won't come out of Park
items.job: Replace brake-shift interlock solenoid or shift lever
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $116-$139 for the interlock solenoid.

items.t: Check engine light that needs a computer update
items.job: Read codes and reprogram engine computer

items.t: Door sensors don't detect open doors
